title: Text, Speech, Vision and Extraction Capabilities

header.html: Describe common text analysis techniques, including keyword extraction, entity detection, sentiment analysis, and summarization; Identify features and capabilities of speech recognition and speech synthesis; Identify features and capabilities of computer vision and image-generation models; Identify techniques to extract information from text, images, audio, and videos
the official AI-901 study guide, skills measured as of April 15, 2026

toc.title: Speech recognition and speech synthesis (Azure Speech)
Techniques to extract information (Azure Content Understanding)

html:
1Services at a glance

Microsoft groups its prebuilt AI services as Foundry Tools (the new name of Azure AI Services). Old name

Capability Foundry Tool Main job
Text analysis Azure Language Understand and analyze text
Speech Azure Speech Speech to text, text to speech, translation
Images Azure Vision Analyze images: captions, tags, objects, text
Information extraction Azure Content Understanding Turn documents, images, audio and video into structured output

2Text analysis techniques (Azure Language)

Azure Language is a cloud-based service with natural language processing (NLP) features for understanding and analyzing text.

Technique What it does Example
Key phrase (keyword) extraction Returns the main concepts of unstructured text as a list "battery life", "screen", "delivery" from a review
Entity detection (named entity recognition) Finds entities and categorizes them into predefined types: person, place, organization, date, quantity "Contoso", "Paris", "March 3"
Sentiment analysis (and opinion mining) Finds positive, negative, neutral or mixed sentiment, and can link it to specific parts of the text "The food was bad, but the staff were kind" = mixed
Summarization Extractive: selects key sentences and keeps their original positions. Abstractive: writes new sentences that capture the meaning. Also for conversations A short summary of a long article
Language detection Detects which language the text is in "French"
PII detection Finds personal information (names, numbers) so it can be hidden Redact a phone number

Microsoft lists PII detection, language detection, named entity recognition and text analytics for health as core capabilities for new development; key phrase extraction, sentiment analysis and summarization are listed as legacy capabilities (still supported). [Verify live]

Exam tip

. Match verb to technique: "main topics" → key phrases; "who, where, when" → entities; "positive or negative" → sentiment; "shorten" → summarization; "which language" → language detection. Extractive copies sentences; abstractive writes new ones.

3Speech recognition and speech synthesis (Azure Speech)

Capability Meaning Features
Speech recognition (speech to text) Turns spoken audio into text Real-time transcription (streaming audio), fast transcription (pre-recorded files), batch transcription (large volumes, asynchronous)
Speech synthesis (text to speech) Turns text into natural-sounding speech Neural voices (humanlike voices from deep neural networks), custom voice (unique to a brand), SSML markup to adjust pitch, pronunciation, speaking rate and volume
Speech translation Translates spoken language, speech to speech or speech to text Live interpretation
Other Language identification, pronunciation assessment Detect the spoken language; score a learner's pronunciation
Exam tip

. SSML is a markup language for speech synthesis settings. Real-time = streaming; batch = many files later; custom voice = brand-specific.

4Computer vision and image-generation models

Analyze images (Azure Vision, image analysis)

Feature What it returns
Caption A sentence that describes the image; dense captions describe several regions
Tags A list of recognized things: objects, living things, scenery, actions
Object detection Which objects and where (bounding boxes)
Read (OCR) Printed and handwritten text found in the image
People detection Where people are, with a confidence score
Smart crop A crop that keeps the important area
Multimodal embeddings Vectors for images and text to support semantic search

The Image Analysis 4.0 service is deprecated and will be retired on September 25, 2028. [Verify live] Newer solutions often use multimodal generative models instead (module 11).

Image-generation models

An image-generation model creates a new image from a text description (a prompt). You can usually choose size and quality. The model name list changes quickly: for example, DALL-E 3 was retired on March 4, 2026, and GPT-Image models are current. [Verify live]

Exam tip

. Analyze an existing image = Azure Vision or a multimodal model. Create a new image = image-generation model. Where is the object = object detection. What does the sign say = Read (OCR).

5Techniques to extract information (Azure Content Understanding)

Azure Content Understanding "uses generative AI to process and ingest many types of content, including documents, images, videos and audio" into a user-defined output format.

Content What it can extract
Documents and forms OCR text, selection marks, barcodes, formulas, layout (paragraphs, sections, tables), and fields you define
Images A summary and fields
Audio A transcript, a summary and speaker labels
Video Key frames, a transcript and chapter segments

Ways to get a field value: Extract (the value as it appears), Classify (choose a category), Generate (write a value, such as a summary). Each field can come with a confidence score from 0 to 1 and grounding (the region where it was found). Output is Markdown (for search) or JSON that matches your schema.

Exam tip

. "Get the invoice total from a PDF" → document extraction. "Get a transcript and speaker labels from a call" → audio analysis. A confidence score tells how reliable a value is.

6Exam Q&A

6.1 Practice questions (choose the best answer)

S1Fabrikam Outdoors wants the main topics mentioned in thousands of reviews. Which technique fits?

  • ASpeech synthesis of the reviews
  • BKey phrase extraction
  • CObject detection in review photos
  • DLanguage detection of each review
Show the answer

Answer: B. Key phrase extraction returns the main concepts of text as a list.

S2A review says "The tent was great, but the zipper broke." The team wants to know how customers feel about each part. Which feature fits?

  • AEntity detection only, without any opinions
  • BSentiment analysis with opinion mining
  • CSpeech translation of the spoken review
  • DSmart crop of the review photos
Show the answer

Answer: B. Sentiment analysis can be linked to specific elements of the text.

S3Which summarization style writes new sentences that capture the meaning?

  • AExtractive
  • BAbstractive
  • CEntity based
  • DBatch
Show the answer

Answer: B. Abstractive summarization generates new sentences; extractive selects existing key sentences.

S4A company must transcribe thousands of recorded calls overnight. Which speech capability fits best?

  • AReal-time transcription
  • BSpeech synthesis with SSML
  • CBatch transcription
  • DPronunciation assessment
Show the answer

Answer: C. Batch transcription processes large volumes of audio asynchronously.

S5A team wants its voice assistant to speak a brand-specific voice and adjust the speaking rate. What should it use?

  • ACustom neural voice and SSML
  • BKey phrase extraction from the text
  • CObject detection in images
  • DSpeech recognition only
Show the answer

Answer: A. Custom voice gives a brand voice, and SSML controls pitch, rate, volume and pronunciation.

S6An app must find where each bicycle is in a street photo. Which feature fits?

  • ACaption
  • BRead (OCR)
  • CLanguage detection
  • DObject detection
Show the answer

Answer: D. Object detection returns the objects and their bounding boxes.

S7Which tool turns recorded sales calls into a transcript with speaker labels and a summary?

  • AAzure Policy for resource rules
  • BA smart crop of the audio
  • CAzure Content Understanding
  • DAn embedding model for search
Show the answer

Answer: C. Content Understanding analyzes audio into a transcript, summary and speaker labels.

6.2 Recall questions

R1Which service analyzes text for key phrases and sentiment?

Show the answer

Azure Language.

R2What is the difference between extractive and abstractive summarization?

Show the answer

Extractive selects existing key sentences; abstractive writes new sentences.

R3What does SSML control?

Show the answer

Pitch, pronunciation, speaking rate and volume of synthesized speech.

R4Which vision feature reads printed and handwritten text in images?

Show the answer

Read (OCR).

R5What do confidence scores in Content Understanding range between?

Show the answer

0 and 1.

R6What was Azure AI Services renamed to?

Show the answer

Foundry Tools.

7Quick Reference Card

Topic Key fact
Azure Language key phrases, entities, sentiment and opinion mining, summarization (extractive, abstractive), language detection, PII
Azure Speech recognition (real-time, fast, batch), synthesis (neural voices, custom voice, SSML), translation
Azure Vision caption, tags, object detection, Read (OCR), people detection; 4.0 retires September 25, 2028
Image generation creates images from text; model names change
Content Understanding documents, images, audio, video; extract, classify, generate; confidence 0 to 1; Markdown or JSON
